verdict.rationale: Lambda documents a REST Cloud API (with an OpenAPI spec) for creating and managing resources, and supports launching instances programmatically. Workloads can be bootstrapped at launch via cloud-init and reached over SSH, so the provision-and-run core is API-driven. Teardown is only implied by "create and manage", and monitoring is evidenced only as a DCGM Grafana dashboard for Managed Kubernetes. The only CLI/MCP evidence is an unofficial community project, which earns no credit. missing for 10: explicitly documented terminate/teardown endpoint, API-accessible instance health/GPU monitoring, official CLI or MCP server, and independent hands-on corroboration of a fully unattended lifecycle.
